             parent_input AS (SELECT "scorecard_id", "metric_id", "item_id", "participation_id" FROM read_parquet(['https://data.spicygov.ai/generations/scorecards/8692fd934f8d1ec15ac0e426e8775f36c904872caa11eee48599b5dbddbf7109/scorecard_metric_items.parquet'], hive_partitioning = false)),
             c AS (SELECT "scorecard_id" AS c0, "metric_id" AS c1, "item_id" AS c2, "participation_id" AS c3, count(*) AS child_rows
                   FROM child_input WHERE "scorecard_id" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_id" IS NOT NULL AND "item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "participation_id" IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY ALL),
             p AS (SELECT "scorecard_id" AS p0, "metric_id" AS p1, "item_id" AS p2, "participation_id" AS p3, count(*) AS parent_rows
                   FROM parent_input WHERE "scorecard_id" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_id" IS NOT NULL AND "item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "participation_id" IS NOT NULL
                   GROUP BY ALL),
             j AS (SELECT c0, c1, c2, c3, child_rows, coalesce(parent_rows, 0) AS parent_rows
                   FROM c LEFT JOIN p ON c.c0 = p.p0 AND c.c1 = p.p1 AND c.c2 = p.p2 AND c.c3 = p.p3)
        SELECT count(*) AS keys, count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_rows=0) AS missing,
               (list(concat_ws('|', c0, c1, c2, c3) ORDER BY c0, c1, c2, c3) FILTER (WHERE parent_rows=0))[1:3] AS examples,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM child_input) AS child_input_rows,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows),0) AS child_nonnull_rows,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_input) AS parent_input_rows,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM p) AS parent_distinct_keys,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM p WHERE parent_rows>1) AS parent_duplicate_keys,
               coalesce((SELECT max(parent_rows) FROM p),0) AS max_parent_multiplicity,
               coalesce(max(parent_rows),0) AS max_matched_parent_multiplicity,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows*parent_rows),0) AS inner_join_rows,
               coalesce(sum(child_rows*greatest(parent_rows,1)),0) AS left_join_nonnull_rows
        FROM j
results.interpretation: Every distinct non-null child composite key resolves in the complete published parent. Parent key is unique across all non-null keys in this publication.
